summary: "Groovy Little Summer Song" is a country song recorded by American country music artist James Otto. It was released in March 2010 as the first single from his album "Shake What God Gave Ya". The song was written by Otto, Al Anderson and Carson Chamberlain.
one_line: A 2010 country single by James Otto, released as the first single from his album "Shake What God Gave Ya".
